title: Bledsoe drawing cell diagrams for Taylor's team

tellings.quote: I'm a carpenter and yet I'm reading papers at night that they would send me and my job was to draw whatever came out of me, whatever I saw.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a carpenter from North Carolina who says UFOs appear around him, says that between 2008 and 2011 he worked for a research team led by a man named Timothy Taylor. He says they sent him scientific papers to read at night, and his job was to draw whatever came out of him, including diagrams of cells. He also names Diana Pasulka, a scholar who studies the subject, in telling it.
